content: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

In Marcus Aurelius's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
